LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 2.1.1 LISTENING FOR COMPREHENSION

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.1: Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension, part of Strand 2 in Grade 9 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to identify the main idea in a text? 2. How can you benefit from technology?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to recordings of stories based on the theme,

2. work with peers to identify pronouns from the listened to recordings,

3. create a list of the pronouns identified and list them on a chart for display,

4. work collaboratively to use the pronouns to construct sentences,

5. discuss the main ideas from the recordings,

6. answer direct and inferential questions from the texts listened to,

7. conduct a debate on the advantages and disadvantages of the internet. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to recordings of stories based on the theme,
2. work with peers to identify pronouns from the listened to recordings,
3. create a list of the pronouns identified and list them on a chart for display,
4. work collaboratively to use the pronouns to construct sentences,
5. discuss the main ideas from the recordings,
6. answer direct and inferential questions from the texts listened to,
7. conduct a debate on the advantages and disadvantages of the internet. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Comprehension together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: This is developed as the learner interacts with digital content when listening to recordings of stories based

on the theme.

• Communication and collaboration: It is developed as the learner speaks engagingly with facts and examples when

conducting a debate on the advantages and disadvantages of the internet.

Values:
• Unity: This is enhanced as the learner collaborates with peers to identify pronouns from the listened to recordings.

• Responsibility: It is developed as the learner engages in assigned roles and duties when conducting a debate on the

advantages and disadvantages of the internet.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

ICT: It is promoted as the learner interacts with texts on ICT and cyber security.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate the concept of listening for comprehension to listening skills in English and Kiswahili.
